name: Zarządzanie wersjami jądra
description: Lists installed Linux kernels (unprivileged, read-only) and removes old ones via the privileged broker, which independently re-derives and locks the running and latest-installed kernel — never trusts the sidecar or frontend on that. Only linux-image-* packages with a real /boot/vmlinuz-<version> file are shown; stale dpkg records and meta-packages (e.g. linux-image-generic-hwe-24.04) are silently excluded, not offered as removable
